**Built for growth in Europe.**
Europe is complex. Markets differ, regulations matter, and local context changes how teams sell. Cognism helps you navigate that complexity with precise data built for the reality of European growth.

Our phone-verified mobiles go through additional verification layers to improve accuracy and reliability. That means fewer dead ends, more conversations with the right people and up to 3x higher connect rates.
##### Decision-maker coverage
**Decision-maker data, refreshed every 30 days.**
Identify and engage senior buyers with accurate, compliant data that is continuously refreshed, so your team knows where to focus and when to act.
##### Compliance
**Compliance-first posture, built in.**
Operate with confidence using compliance-first B2B data, strong governance standards and extensive Do-Not-Call coverage across Europe.

## Frequently asked questions...
##### Who is Cognism best suited for?
Cognism is leveraged by Enterprise and mid-market sales, marketing and revenue operations teams working in B2B markets. Teams with at least 5 salespeople often see the most value, especially those prospecting into Europe, but [speak to us today](https://www.cognism.com/demo) about your requirements.
##### How quickly can we get set up and start seeing value?
After initial onboarding, you'll be able to get started straight away. We'll give you the resources you need to start building your target lists, ideal personas or discover new contact information in old places, and explore the opportunities within our database.
##### Do you have pricing or plans designed for small teams?
Cognism pricing is based on your business needs.
Cognism costs do differ depending on the package you choose, but we have no hidden cost associated with access to the platform, keeping your outgoings predictable.
All packages include contact and company data, including our phone-verified contacts, target market analytics and integrations to leading CRM and engagement tools.
##### How accurate is your data, and how often is it refreshed?
Cognism’s proprietary data fusion engine is responsible for sourcing data from across the internet - everything from news reports, press releases, earnings reports, public registries and validated third-party vendors.
Our AI stitches hundreds of pieces of data together per company before filtering it through a series of verification layers to create high-quality company and contact records. We do all this to find you the key phone-verified decision makers.
Our Director level and above data is continually refreshed on a 30 day basis to maintain accuracy and completeness across our database.
##### Are you GDPR/UK GDPR compliant?
Security is a top priority for Cognism because it’s fundamental to everything we do, our customers and our product.
Our security and compliance teams are dedicated to maintaining parity with ISO 27001 and SOC2 frameworks.
Our global database complies with the latest in international privacy laws, including GDPR and CCPA, helping you connect with prospects with confidence.
**Learn more about our compliance programme on our compliance hub.**
